claims.claim_text: The indexed Major Jackson L. Bostwick is a high-confidence match to Jackson Leonard Bostwick, the OSS and SSU China Theater surgeon.
claims.evidence_excerpt: China Theater surgeon Jackson Bostwick ... was still in country on 1 January 1946.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A CIA institutional history identifies Jackson Bostwick as the China Theater surgeon, while a University of Minnesota record supplies the uncommon middle name Leonard and neurosurgical specialty.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare exact first and last name, matching middle initial, indexed major rank, explicit OSS context, and independently corroborated medical specialty.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources establish OSS and immediate post-OSS SSU medical service, but do not identify an employer or assignment before OSS.
claims.match_notes: The University record is postwar and is used only to corroborate identity. No pre-OSS employer is inferred from his profession or education.

claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare exact name, middle initial, commissioned Army context, explicit OSS assignment, and corroborating prewar radio and directory evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The radio profile documents wartime Signal Corps assignment to OSS but does not state the accession date or prove which affiliation was immediately prior.
claims.match_notes: An exact-name Army bulk row was rejected because its private identifier and enlisted grade conflict with the index. No Signal Corps chronology beyond the cited wording is inferred.

claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare exact name and middle initial, independently corroborated radio background, commissioned service, and explicit OSS context.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented in 1941 before OSS service, but the directory does not establish this as the last civilian employer or immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
